name: terminal-animado
description: Animated backgrounds for the VS Code terminal: snow drifting with the wind, slanted rain with flashes and bolts in the sky and splashes on the river, embers with rising sparks and smoke. GPU animation, without freezing the editor.

enumDescriptions: Glittering flakes drifting with the wind, snow piled up below
Slanted rain, flashes in the sky and drops splashing on the river
Rising sparks, smoke and glowing embers below
terminalAnimado.effect.description: Effect shown in the panel background.

terminalAnimado.tintInterface.description: Tints the interface colors (bars, buttons, badges) to match the effect: embers in translucent red, snow in ice grey, rain in greyish blue. Colors only — no size or layout changes. When the effect is removed or this is turned off, your original colors come back.

enumDescriptions: A single layer — lighter when resizing the panel
